note: Amendment C6, and the line the kernel draws. The engine reports a well-formed address it never wrote. The kernel copies the list verbatim — it checks the form and nothing else, because deciding whether an engine really wrote what it says it wrote is not a thing a gate can do without becoming the engine — so the admission is granted and the record says what was claimed. The claim is not thereby true: the object is not in the CAS, the export lists it under `derivedObjects` and under `missingObjects` both, and the verifier is what falsifies it. A bundle that states its gaps is the point; a kernel that silently dropped the entry would leave the receipt citing nothing.

kind.description: A thing whose admission the deriving test engine decides, and writes a record of.

spec.title: the kernel records the claim; the verifier judges it
